title: Statistics for health
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with the University of Burundi
about: CIMPA research school organised by the Institute of Applied Statistics, University of Burundi, 14-25 June 2027 in Bujumbura. Topics include disease risk factors, prevalence and incidence, analysis of historical data and prediction of disease spread. Applications close 14 February 2027.

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: "Statistics for health" (field) → "Build a practical foundation in descriptive statistics by summarizing datasets, examining distributions, and interpreting measures of central tendency."

"disease risk factors, prevalence and incidence" → "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."

"prediction of disease spread" → "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
